verdict.rationale: MX ships official SDKs for embedding the Connect Widget (Web SDK, React Native SDK) plus a first-party OpenAPI spec on GitHub and Postman collection for API integration, giving AI-native developers a documented path to build against MX programmatically. However, evidence shows no broad set of official server-side client-library SDKs (e.g., Python/Node/Java API clients) beyond the widget SDKs and generic OpenAPI spec, and a direct openapi.json probe 404'd, suggesting the spec isn't uniformly hosted as advertised. missing for 10: dedicated backend-language SDKs beyond widget embedding, working hosted OpenAPI endpoint, independent corroboration of SDK quality/usage.
